FAQ

Everything you need to know today

Browse through these common inquiries to better understand our patient-focused medical platform.

See Doctors

See Doctors

Contact us

Contact us

Do you accept insurance?

We accept most major insurance plans to ensure your medical care remains affordable and accessible.

How do I book or reschedule an appointment?

You can easily book, cancel, or reschedule your visits directly through our secure patient dashboard anytime.

Can I consult a doctor online?

Yes, our platform offers secure video consultations with certified specialists from the comfort of home

Do your doctors issue prescriptions?

Our licensed physicians provide digital prescriptions that are sent directly to your preferred local pharmacy.

How do I choose the right specialist?

Browse through detailed doctor profiles, verified patient ratings, and specific areas of medical expertise online

Is my medical information kept private?

We utilize advanced industry-standard encryption to keep all your personal health data completely confidential.

Still have more questions?

Book a call with our friendly team to learn how MedicareX simplifies your healthcare journey.
